When you regain control, go next door and watch a series of events unfold.
You'll eventually regain control outside of the hotel. Make your way to Zhen's
bar to see an event. Watch some dialogue here, then head back outside the bar.

  NOTE     From here on out, there are Japanese soldiers (Corporals) all over
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the city. They will appear randomly in battle, and if you talk to
           one of them, you'll have to fight them as well.

Go to the intersection near the hotel to run into Kato, who'll tell you of
another event that happened, and also where to find the key that will let you
into Kuihai Tower. Make your way east to the next area, then southwest back
down to the dock, and head over to the ship. Open the fish well on the left
side of the ship, and you'll find the [_YAWANG GATE KEY_] wrapped in cloth.

Make your way back to the second floor of the Inn, to the back room. Watch the
event here and fight a couple of Sergeants, then finish out the dialogue.

Meanwhile, in Kuihai Tower...

You see Alice trapped. Watch the dialogue, and PLEASE pay attention, or you
will miss out on a side quest. Answer with the following replies:

————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
   ———>   [1] Quit it, you dirty old man!        <———
          ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
          [2] This strange machine is so sexy!

          [3] Please don't hurt me...
————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
   ———>   [1] Just get away from me!             <———
          ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
          [2] This scary tower is sexy, too!

          [3] Please, stop...
————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
   ———>   [1] Ignore him.                        <———
          ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
          [2] But YOU'RE the sexiest!

          [3] Forgive me...
————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

   Choosing ANYTHING other than what's specified above will lead to you not
being able to go to Kowloon and do the side quest there. Watch the rest of the
events, and you'll eventually regain control.

_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

You'll regain control at the entrance to Kuihai Tower. LEAVE NOW, as there is
more to do. Head back to Huayuan in Shanghai.

At the intersection near the hotel, head east to the next section. Head south
toward the dock, but stop at the fork with the shop at Mika's House. Go
southeast and enter the building that was previously locked. There's nothing
too terribly important here, but if you check the cabinet at the top of the
screen that a bird cage is sitting on, you can get a [_TEAOFTHEHEALER_].

Make your way to the dock now where you'll find several dogs, along with the
Man with Dog. Talk to him to play a game: Shanghai's famous dog-picking
contest! Pay him 300 Cash, and you'll be able to play. Pick a dog, then it'll
move around, and you'll have to pick him again when you're done. It's basically
a glorified cup game. Here are your prizes for winning.

 - First win (three dogs) - A [_LOTTERY TICKET_]!
 - Second win (four dogs) - A [_LEONARDO'S BEAR_]!
 - Third win (four dogs) - A [_MONKEY PAW_]!

That's it for treasure in Shanghai. Now, you can either continue with Kuihai
Tower, or you can take on a couple of side quests! If you don't care about the
side quests, then continue on to W-1-11 - Kuihai Tower. Otherwise, read below!
